events.title: Drive Your Way with Two Controller Schemas
events.summary: Welcome back to another update for Wacky Drivers. Today we're talking about something fundamental: how you actually control your car. Since the early days of the project, I've used a "Point-and-Go" system (my favorite). It's intuitive, it works great on mobile, and it makes the game feel snappy. But as we've moved towards a full Steam release and added Split screen support, I realized that not everyone wants to drive the same way. That's why I've implemented a second controller schema! events.title: Local Splitscreen & Steam Achievements Are Coming to Wacky Drivers
